summary.text: Dennis Paul is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 129 who has served since 2015 and is running for Texas Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Shannon Dicely.

paragraphs.text: Dennis Paul assumed office in the Texas House in 2015 and is not running for re-election to District 129 in 2026.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 11.
For 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Insurance Committee, the House Higher Education Committee as vice chair, and the Local & Consent Calendars Committee.
